The following tables presents the design ground motions in terms of peak ground accelerations $PGA=S_a(0)$ for different service levels (return periods), site conditions according to NRC 2020, and confidence levels.


```{r echo=FALSE}
TR_TARGET <- c(100,200,500,1000,2500,5000,10000)
po_TARGET <- c(0.05,0.10,0.16,0.50,"mean",0.84,0.90,0.95)
```


```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-PGA_140
#| tbl-cap: "Design Ground Motions for Vs30=140 m/s - PGA[g]" 
Vs30_TARGET <- 140
# FIX BUG in gmdp when Vs30o different than Vref.
DT <- gmdp::buildTable.Sa(UHSTable,Tno=0,Vs30o=Vs30_TARGET,po=po_TARGET,TRo = TR_TARGET)
setnames(DT,old = c("TR[yr]","PGA[g]","Tn[s]","Vs30[m/s]"),new = c("TR","PGA","Tn","Vs30"))
LT1 <- DT[p==0.50,.(TR,"50%"= PGA,Vs30)]
LT2 <- DT[p=="mean",.(TR,"mean"=PGA,Vs30)]
AUX <- LT1[LT2,on=.(TR,Vs30)]
LT <- DT[p==0.95,.(TR,"95%"=PGA,Vs30)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30)]
LT <- DT[p==0.90,.(TR,"90%"=PGA,Vs30)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30)]
LT <- DT[p==0.84,.(TR,"84%"=PGA,Vs30)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30)]

AUX|> setcolorder(neworder = c("TR","50%","mean","84%","90%","95%")) 
AUX |> buildTable(library="gt") |> 
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c("50%","mean","84%","90%","95%"),decimals = 2) 
```
